responsibility: Implements the analyzer’s heap-allocation checker for malloc/free, new/delete, realloc, and user-defined allocator/deallocator pairs exposed via malloc attributes. The file defines a rich allocation state machine keyed by deallocator sets rather than individual allocators, tracks nullness, non-heap pointers, freed state, frame-local assumed-non-null refinements, leak and double-free style diagnostics, special handling for realloc moves, and policy hooks for merge/purge/unknown-call behavior so heap lifetime state integrates correctly with exploded-graph exploration and region_model updates.
